target_customer: Dental groups (DSOs) and dental practices that pay for charting, coaching and case acceptance tools
problem: Dental providers lose time charting and miss coachable moments that would raise case acceptance.
business_model: B2B SaaS for dental practices and DSOs
product_category: Dental AI scribe, voice perio agents and coaching

founders.name: Daniel Bessonov
education: University of Pennsylvania, master's (M&T per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; most recently product intelligence lead at Wispr.

founders.name: Justin Zhou
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; led automation architecture at Infinitus and was lead PM for Page Shield at Cloudflare.

technical_complexity.rationale: Ambient dental scribing, voice perio charting and integration with Open Dental and Dentrix is standard AI engineering with domain-specific accuracy work.

defensibility.rationale: Practice management integrations and coaching data help, but Overjet, Pearl and others offer overlapping features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Overjet markets DSO coaching and case acceptance tracking and Pearl lists ambient voice charting (vendor pages, 2025); no source shows them acquiring Avora.

market_need_then: Dental groups consolidating into DSOs seek consistency and time savings; the company reports hundreds of practices deployed and 10x revenue growth in a year (company claims).

rebrands.why: Shifted from patient-facing treatment explainers to a scribe and coaching platform for practice staff, per press summary

brand_strength.rationale: Invented name is short and distinctive and replaced a descriptive name that no longer fit the product, but no brand press or community evidence found.

pivots.from: ShowAndTell: AI agents creating patient-facing treatment plan explanations
pivots.to: Avora: AI scribe, voice perio and coaching for dental staff
pivots.why: Shift toward tools for the practice's own staff, per press summary

outcome_analysis: Avora started as ShowAndTell in YC Fall 2024, then rebranded and pivoted to a dental scribe and coaching platform, launching publicly in August 2025 with backing from CRV and YC and later announcing a $2.3M seed. It reports hundreds of practices and 10x revenue growth, company claims. Competition from Overjet and Pearl remains the main risk.
notes: Seed date given only as 2026 because sources conflict on timing (one listing says June 2026); CRV as lead is unconfirmed beyond a press quote, investor list may be incomplete. Competitor list is empty because only 2025 vendor pages were found. Education for Zhou: YC page says Penn with no degree. Launch press release dated August 2025 per search summary; the rename date is approximate.
